title: Black Filmmakers Hall of Fame — Binder OC-002
description: Thirty-five cataloged objects from one binder: a 1987 Oscar Micheaux Awards announcement, 27 photographs, and seven film/contact assemblies.
status: Working public gallery · research and rights review ongoing
credits: Materials held in the Jacob Blanchette Jr. Photography Archive; photographer attribution for individual photographs not established.
eyebrow: Black Filmmakers Hall of Fame · Binder OC-002
gallery_description: Browse 35 preliminary digitizations from the BFHF binder, with original-page filters and item identifiers. Dates, subjects, photographer attribution and album chronology remain under research.
notice: Working archival gallery: some crops and tones need review. The February 22, 1987 Oscar Micheaux Awards announcement provides context, but does not prove that every photograph was made at that event. Additional film/contact materials may reflect other events. Names, authorship, copyright and dates are under review.

title: Black Repertory Group — 25th Anniversary (1990)
description: First-pass gallery of 21 mounted photographs from the Black Repertory Group 25th anniversary album.
gallery_description: Twenty-one preliminary crops from six photographed album pages. Browse by provisional album page, search descriptions, or use the slideshow. Individual dates and identities remain unverified.
notice: Working digitization: several crops still need checking. The album title page dates the anniversary celebration July 20–22, 1990; that does not independently establish each photograph's date. Photographer credits and publication rights remain under review.
credits: From the Jacob Blanchette Jr. Photography Archive; individual photographers not yet verified.
